limitations: The scientific paper (PMID 34510746) is not open access in Europe PMC and was not read; no claim cites it. Parameters come from PRIDE text and deposited mqpar.xml/RAW headers.
Group letters: C is read as control and S as acid treated (by elimination of the two-group design); the deposit does not define the letters explicitly.
Biological replicate numbers 1-7 are ordinal per donor pair in file order; the deposited ID numbers (8.1...) are not decoded; no individual column since donor identity is not documented.
Carbamyl N-term is in the protocol text but not in the deposited mqpar.xml; it is included from the text, written as Any N-term (position not verifiable).
The deposited community-annotated SDRF in the PRIDE file list was not consulted.
Treatment values are free text (not NCIT/EFO terms); parse_sdrf warns accordingly.

Revised after review: HCD and 25 NCE taken from RAW method headers of four files (confirmed for all 14 by the independent reviewer); C/S = control/acid-treated corroborated by higher B2M LFQ in C than S in proteinGroups; Carbamyl N-term comes from PRIDE protocol text only (not in mqpar.xml).
